rationale: The B-to-C drag shows pavement, but the cost popup and selection outline obscure its endpoint and connection. Move the pointer away and inspect after the overlays clear.
expected_effect: The road corner and C endpoint become unobscured so both connected legs and the clear X tiles can be assessed.

checkpoint.evidence: The comparison strip shows new gray pavement extending down-right from B, but red cost text and the white selection outline cover the C endpoint; the complete connection cannot yet be confirmed.
